answer_1.quote: With only a few recent exceptions, however, ArgSum has up-to-date been mostly tackled with pre-LLM solutions... Our contributions are: (i) We integrate LLMs into existing ArgSum systems... (ii) We introduce two new LLM-based ArgSum systems...

answer_2.quote: We apply the Soft-Score... with the following automatic metrics: (1) ROUGE 1, (2) BERTScore F1, (3) Mover-Score, (4) BARTScore, (5) BLEURT and (6) MENLI... Coverage Score... utilizes a Match Scorer.

answer_3.quote: We introduce two one-shot prompting strategies for assessing ArgSum systems... We leverage GPT-4o-mini... into the LLM-based evaluation metric... The LLM-based metrics for coverage and redundancy... achieve maximum correlation of 0.767... and 0.852...

answer_4.quote: To verify the reliability of the automatic evaluation metrics, we conduct a human evaluation of 126 generated argument summaries... carried out by four experienced annotators... We assess the dimensions of coverage and redundancy... Guidelines can be found in Appendix C.
